asr.full_text: Hello guys welcome back to heavenlybound Today we have a highly requested video for all of you Today it is about our daily routine so watch it carefully and watch this in the end It has 2 parts one is today is second is in next video Have fun watching it Subscribe to our channel Heavenly Bound and to press the Bell for regular updates. Arav's day starts at 7.30 am to 8 am. I want to be with you always! When he wakes up in the morning, he cuddles me for sometime. we enjoy the 5-10 minutes in the bed only, then he wake up from the bed. As you can see now, Aar he has put on his favorite pillow. After getting up, Aryan will brush a lot. He enjoys this procedure and brush his face in the most fun way. He doesn't harass anyone. We have made an episode on brushing I hope you all watch it and get your children engaged with the process your kids also will enjoy this process you can see first child goes on brushing than I brush his tongue now lets clean his tongue he enjoys doing so The most enjoyable time is when he comes to my cafe for a shower. It is more effective if we use it during summer time rather than in winter. I am adding some water to this baby hydrated spray. It is most effective in the morning. I am using this. I had put these sprays in the past and I have used it for many times. 2. After making milk, she drink milk happily even though she use straw and can drink milk in glass After brushing her and having milk in the morning then we give cow milk in which also we put some sugar Aarif like milk very much Now we are gonna add some Aaraf's favourite milk- sugar in it. At this stage, he is able to sit comfortably with his tummy full as he is hungry all night. Music I am in hurry and want to play in the park with my child. He can play with his toys only for an hour during the afternoon. Sometimes we also want to indulge him. You too try to get indulge with his child So indulge yourself with your kids If you like this video then like this video and share to everyone So that everyone get happy to watch this video I am sure you both will like it You also participate with you kids and so have fun Especially Arav loves music but its fun playing music with them & remembering my childhood Especially, Aarab loves to play music & loves it so much that he also plays casios Aarav got out and sat down to eat his breakfast in the meantime. Today, Aarav's breakfast is upma of semolina and he likes it a lot, so for breakfast, he is having upma of semolina. it is 9 in the morning right now. At this time in the morning, he have he breakfast and also have lunch at almost 9pm and his eating time is almost 5-10mins He likes it so he eat fast Alright let's take him to eat his breakfast Please subscribe our channel for more such amazing videos. Here i would like to request you that Aarav likes to dance a lot. He gets his favorite dance from google home Seeing his small moves make us happy. You too get these small moves and you can do different indoor activities for kids. I hope this will be beneficial for you And I hope that you are enjoying it too You give this kind of indoor activities to your children So that they are satisfied with this After waking up he has done lot of activities. So he gets little tired So we give him a mid morning snack And preferably it is a fruit And he likes to eat banana if Arif is tired then he gives mid morning snack preferably that will be fruit and banana then start on best massage time helps in growth & development Massage time is a magical therapy for baby's It reduces all the fatigue Plus helps a lot in growth and development Aarav is enjoying his massage time At that time we open the balcony door And he gets happiness by seeing birds Thank you. Time to go for massage Masage takes half an hour That's Aarav's best time He enjoys bath a lot So this time as his best time he loves water very much all the baby is water baby after taking bath, he don't want to leave he thinks time goes on and the baby keep bathing you can see that is enjoying with the bath Only his dad baths him Otherwise I keep him and he enjoys in the bath time Mom throw him out quickly But dad loves to bathe Keep on giving him baths So I went looking for my baby with her in the streets for lunch and finally, the time to say goodbye. And finally, it's lunchtime… and how they do puri like this potato puri and potato puri I am hungry ahhh Saroj I am hungry today in Aravs food we have potato puri and potato curry for that we fry puri in desi ghee because for kids its very healthy plus potatoes are also very healthy he enjoys the lunch lot he likes puri and potato very, sometimes he doesn't like to eat puri or aloo but he will eat if we make him roti with ghee. Or else he just likes to have puri, paratha. We give him puri etc. in clarified oil. We never use refined oil for his meal As you can see he enjoys it very much Now he prefers to eat himself He feels like he gets its plated by hands Now he is eating it You can see he is enjoying it very much Guys this was Aarav's routine for the day After this, he takes a nap after the lunch He wakes up with a complete routine of these 4 days after that he takes his nap after the lunch after lunch and nap he wakes up every evening all his routine till night so we will share till night in next video so you should see it and if you like the video then like it and subscribe the channel do not forget dont forget to subscribe
